latestVersion.changelog:
image-ocr-local-aipc v1.0.0

- Initial release of local image OCR skill for Windows using the GLM-OCR model.
- Recognizes and extracts text from images, supporting mixed Chinese/English.
- Prioritizes Intel iGPU (Vulkan) for on-device inference, no cloud API needed.
- Automatic setup: checks/installations for llama.cpp, model downloads, and environment preparation.
- Supports progress announcements, user opt-in for large initial model downloads, and manual model fallback.
